reviews.text: Erik did a professional job installing a new HVAC system at my residence. He was prompt and courteous and kept things clean. He answered all my questions to my satisfaction. I would use him again and again. Great job!
reviews.author: Doug W.

reviews.text: Boro Mechanical has been servicing and repairing my plumbing & hvac needs for years. Erik is honest, reliable and knowledgeable. I only use Boro Mechanical and highly recommend them.
reviews.author: Debra R.

reviews.text: Excellent hvac contractor, very knowledge and reasonable prices. Have had Boro Mechanical help us on 3-4 homes. Very satisfied each and every time.
reviews.author: Trey J.
